propositions: After rebase:chain creates a new patchset per chain member, all members must carry a fresh Verified +1 on their own post-rebase SHAs before submit; submitting while any member lacks fresh Verified lands an untested tree (violates R5).
The autolander must await fresh Verified up to a bounded timeout (default 30 min, configurable); on timeout, hand the stack back via S2b mechanism rather than blocking indefinitely.

Submit must be ancestor-atomic via a single POST /changes/{tip-id}/submit call on the chain tip, leveraging Gerrit's relation-chain and shared topic (stack_id) with change.submitWholeTopic to enforce all-or-nothing submission.

After submit call completes, the loop must verify every stack member reached MERGED status; if any member remains open (partial land), the system must fail loudly with AUTOLANDER_ERROR metric and hand the stack back rather than proceeding.
On full-merge success, the autolander must close or annotate associated tickets via rebar ticket operations.
